name: MacStadium · Round 1
domainSummary: A managed Mac infrastructure capability providing hosted bare-metal Apple hardware, macOS virtualization, ephemeral virtual machines, remote desktop access, and scalable CI, testing, and platform workloads.
evidenceBoundary: Do not reproduce Apple or MacStadium products, logos, device silhouettes, data-center photography, or literal racks. Use managed-compute architecture only.

researchSources.title: MacStadium platform solutions
researchSources.use: Official bare metal, macOS virtualization, ephemeral VM, remote access, CI, and testing capabilities.
